statements.status_notes: The DHI libssh2 package backports the upstream transport.c packet_length bounds fix from https://github.com/libssh2/libssh2/commit/97acf3dfda80c91c3a8c9f2372546301d4a1a7a8 as dhi-cve-2026-55200-transport-packet-length-bound.patch, which rejects packets whose length exceeds LIBSSH2_PACKET_MAXPAYLOAD and prevents the out-of-bounds heap write.

The DHI libssh2 package backports the upstream SSH_MSG_EXT_INFO parse-failure fix from https://github.com/libssh2/libssh2/commit/17626857d20b3c9a1addfa45979dadcee1cd84a4 as upstream-cve-2026-55199.patch, which breaks the extension-parsing loop on _libssh2_get_string() failure and prevents the pre-authentication CPU-exhaustion loop.
